methodology.displayName: Co-Fund project additionality and cooperative allocation model v1

estimandDefinitions.success_case_additional: The project resource or deliverable that would be created if the frozen Co-Fund succeeds, net of any project quantity that a participant or identified outside funder would supply under the frozen no-pool defaults.
estimandDefinitions.expected_additional: The change in project-delivery probability caused by the participant’s inclusion multiplied by the success-case additional quantity, reported in each native unit.
estimandDefinitions.direct_causal_attribution: The verified project quantity attributable to a participant under the approved inclusion-versus-exclusion model, capped at verified additional project quantity and not summed with cooperative allocation.
estimandDefinitions.verified_additional: The project resource or deliverable independently verified after settlement and delivery, net of frozen no-pool defaults and any independently funded substitute.
estimandDefinitions.cooperative_allocation: A non-additive Shapley allocation of verified or expected coalition-created project quantity across participants, using the frozen contribution and fallback structure.

methodology.baselineDefinition: Before publication, freeze each participant’s maximum budget, no-pool purchase plan, any outside funding, the exact project cost, split rule, deliverables, substitution rule, withdrawal rule, and what happens if a participant exits. A project is additional only to the extent that the same or a substitutable project would not be funded under those defaults.
methodology.algorithmDescription: Compute the deterministic project gap and success-case deliverables from frozen terms. Estimate delivery probability with and without each participant using a hierarchical model of resolved Co-Funds. Report each participant’s direct inclusion effect separately. Compute a Shapley allocation over the coalition value function for a fairness view, but never add that allocation to direct causal attribution. After delivery, replace modeled deliverables with verified quantities and retain model uncertainty for counterfactual additionality.

referenceClassPolicy.uncertaintyExpansionRule: Expand the predictive interval for each dropped matching field and add coalition-composition variance. Withhold if no class supports both delivery probability and no-pool-default calibration.

uncertaintyPolicy.method: Use hierarchical survival and completion models for funding and delivery, posterior simulation for no-pool substitution, and deterministic or seeded-permutation Shapley calculations with Monte Carlo error included in the 80% interval.
uncertaintyPolicy.confidencePolicy: Withhold when model health is blocked or stale. Label low confidence only after health passes and the eligible sample is at least 40; moderate requires at least 80 eligible resolved observations, no more than one approved reference-class broadening step, and no blocking calibration failure; high requires at least 160 observations, the narrowest approved class, empirical 80% coverage between 75% and 85%, calibration slope between 0.8 and 1.2, and no active warnings.

requiredCalibrationMetrics: Brier score for modeled completion or activation probability
blockedConditions: eligible resolved-observation count below the methodology minimum
80% interval empirical coverage outside the approved tolerance
required state is missing or does not match the immutable state hash
input is outside the approved domain
unresolved evidence-integrity, duplication, or overlap failure
coalition value is non-monotone under the approved project definition
no-pool defaults are missing for any material participant
warningConditions: reference class broadened beyond the narrowest approved class
sample size below the high-confidence threshold
calibration drift within the warning band
material share of observations relies on participant attestation rather than independent evidence
project has a close substitute with uncertain outside funding

sourceDataRequirements: immutable project specification, invoice or quoted cost, and deliverables
participant identities or stable pseudonymous participant keys
each participant’s frozen no-pool default and budget cap
exact split, withdrawal, shortfall, and substitution rules
settlement and external payment evidence references
delivery evidence and independent review outcome
audited resolved Co-Fund outcomes including failures and substitutions
knownFailureModes: participants strategically exaggerate no-pool defaults or willingness to pay
an outside funder would have supplied the project anyway
project quality differs from the frozen specification
Shapley approximation error is hidden or treated as direct causation
currency totals are combined without an immutable conversion snapshot
outOfDomainConditions: project cost or deliverables remain materially mutable after terms freeze
participant obligations are unbounded or cannot be expressed in stable native units
project creates material uncompensated third-party harms
no defensible no-pool default exists for one or more material participants
coalition exceeds the approved approximation capacity or fails monotonicity checks
materialChangeTriggers: reference-class fields, broadening order, or minimum sample size changes
probability, uncertainty, or confidence method changes
new data source or evidence-quality tier
aggregation, overlap, or double-counting rule changes
new participant role or lifecycle state
change to shortfall, withdrawal, substitution, or automatic-obligation rules

aggregationPolicy.overlapHandling: A verified resource, action, signer, or deliverable may appear in multiple explanatory views, but may enter an additive platform aggregate at most once. Direct causal attribution and cooperative allocation are alternative attribution lenses and are never summed. Currency, count, duration, and value-adjusted quantities remain separate unless an independently approved immutable conversion snapshot exists.

shapleyPolicy.characteristicFunctionDefinition: For any subset of participants, coalition value is the additional verified or expected project quantity delivered by that subset under the frozen cost, split, fallback, shortfall, and substitution rules, relative to the frozen no-pool defaults.
shapleyPolicy.approximationMethod: Above 12 participants, use 20,000 deterministic seeded random permutations, publish the Monte Carlo standard error, and withhold the allocation if the error exceeds 5% of the coalition value or if coalition-value monotonicity checks fail.

parameters.publicationRule: withhold modeled components unless exact-hash model approval and current health pass exist
